propositions: rebar has a durable event-sourced history but no aggregation layer to surface how the agent-driven dev loop trends over time.
A single dynamic date-range rebar metrics command surfaces metrics across three lenses: agent-loop health, codebase decay, and gate value.

Three Tier-C blindspots (env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance, bug outcome classification) leave no durable event-store trace and are closed by passive emissions stamped by trustworthy code.

caused_by provenance is auto-derived best-effort from git blame of the pre-fix state over the bug's file_impact, skipped when ambiguous, and overridable via --caused-by; auto-derived edges are non-authoritative.
The bug-close path replaces the required free-text --reason with a required bounded --class enum persisted on the STATUS event without increasing required-argument count.
Backfilled and classified values are labeled source=backfill_classified with confidence=classified and are never aggregated into authoritative structural series.
